Description: Sync ADRs to GitHub as real Issues (not Draft Issues), with the repository's tasks linked as sub-issues of their related ADR. Not yet designed - this task is the handoff/starting point for a fresh session.

Logs.Justification: Design interview completed with the user; all open questions resolved (task promotion cascades automatically, PAT/config reused with upgraded scope, TaskSyncLink/TaskSyncState renamed to shared SyncLink/SyncState, dedicated ADR Status project field). Decision documented in ADR 00010 (Proposed). Ready to move into implementation.

Implementation complete: SyncLink/SyncState/SyncBatchResult/SyncItemResult/SyncItemOutcome renamed to shared types; AdrRecord gained SyncLinks and RelatedTasks; new AdrBodyFormat, IAdrSyncProvider, GitHubProjectsAdrSyncProvider (export/import/discover/EnsureSubIssueAsync), NoOpAdrSyncProvider; new AdrGitHubSync command handler with adr-export/adr-import CLI commands and adr_export/adr_import MCP tools; new adr-link-task/adr-unlink-task (CLI) and adr_link_task/adr_unlink_task (MCP) on IAdrLink; GitHubProjectsSettings extended with TargetRepository/AdrStatusFieldName/AdrImportStatusMap/AdrExportStatusMap; unit tests added for the new provider, command handler, AdrBodyFormat, and AdrRecord changes; existing task-sync tests updated for the rename. Not run through dotnet build/test yet - user reviews and compiles themselves per their standing preference.

Title: Design and implement ADR sync to GitHub (Issues with tasks as sub-issues)
